name: image-to-editable-ppt
description: Convert images and PDFs into visually faithful, editable PowerPoint presentations using AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Faithful images and PDFs to editable PowerPoint
interface.longDescription: Recreate existing image and PDF layouts as editable PowerPoint objects. Preserve wording and visual design, render the output, compare it with the source, and correct local differences. Native chart data editing is optional. Development preview: Claude.ai and Microsoft application checks remain pending.
